---
title: Section references
author: Test Author
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: article
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: In an article, whose sections have numbers, a reference to a section keeps the number that Typst writes.
        check: bash _checks/xref.sh section 'Section 1'
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrors: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['See #ref\(<sec-intro>, supplement: \[']
---
